blocks.summary: Pete Hegseth en Amérique latine : Washington renforce ses alliances sécuritaires. Avec une tournée au Venezuela, en Colombie et en Équateur, le secrétaire américain à la Défense, Pete Hegseth, entend renforcer la coopération militaire de Washington en Amérique latine, notamment dans la lutte contre le narcotrafic.

blocks.summary: Some creators are skeptical of Instagram’s new affiliate program. For years, influencers have come up with workarounds on social media to figure out how to share affiliate links with followers.  A new integration between Instagram and Amazon was announced earlier this month as a way to make it easier for influencers to make money from affiliate links - but some content creators are suspicious about who really benefits.
